narr: Daytime heating helped fuel storms as they developed along a cold front that passed through Central New York. Locally heavy rainfall produced areas of flash flooding and related damages in the region.
ev: Flooding occurred on the Vestal Parkway. Water flowing across the road with parking lots taking on deep water.
Water was rushing down Reynolds Road and Harry L. Drive.
Several roads flooded in the area, including Mount Upton and South New Berlin. State Route 8 inundated in several places.
A road was flooded and covered with mud and debris.
Numerous roads were reported as washed out in the area, including State Route 8.
A bridge was flooded. Hay bales were blocking the creek underpass. The local fire department was flooded out.
